name: ds-solution-architect
description: Turns a client use case into a rigorous, implementation-ready data science / ML solution plan (delivered as a Word document): problem framing, data feasibility, preprocessing, baselines, algorithm trade-offs, metrics, experiment design, validation and leakage control, statistical and causal inference, deployment and monitoring, and a phased roadmap. Includes Healthcare, BFSI and Retail domain packs.
